flow_analysis.root_cause: The application architecture has a split between the main backend service and an auxiliary OpenAI API server. The frontend expects all endpoints to be in the main backend, but some critical endpoints for the chat clarification flow only exist in the auxiliary server. This architectural mismatch causes the chat refinement feature to fail, which is a key part of the user flow for improving SMART goals.
